LanguageData.RimAgent.Tool.ToggleTip: Click to show or hide the arguments and result.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Screenshot.Pending: The screenshot has not been written yet, or the file was moved.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Window.ResizeTip: Drag the bottom-right corner to resize the window
LanguageData.RimAgent.Placeholder: Tell the agent what to do, or type / for commands
LanguageData.RimAgent.ConfirmNote: The plan above is a preview — nothing has changed yet.
LanguageData.RimAgent.ToolsStripped: Tools were not available for this reply: the model that answered does not support tool calling, so nothing was changed.
LanguageData.RimAgent.CombatLatencyNote: Combat orders arrive several seconds after you speak. Use them for positioning and retreats, not real-time fighting.
LanguageData.RimAgent.NoFunctionCalling: None of the models in your RimLLM Framework fallback chain supports tool calling, so the agent cannot act. Adjust the chain in RimLLM Framework's mod settings.
LanguageData.RimAgent.NoProvider: RimLLM Framework has no usable provider: {0}. Configure one in RimLLM Framework's mod settings.
LanguageData.RimAgent.FrameworkNotInitialized: RimLLM Framework did not initialize. Check the debug log for errors when RimLLM Framework was loading.
LanguageData.RimAgent.FrameworkTooOld: The installed RimLLM Framework is too old for RimAgent. Update it to a version from 2026-09-12 or later.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Error.Configuration: The LLM provider refused the request ({0}). Check the API key, credit and fallback chain in RimLLM Framework's mod settings.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Error.Transient: The request did not get through ({0}). Try again in a moment.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Error.ContextTooLong: The conversation is too long for the model. Press Clear and start again.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.PermissionsHeader: What the agent is allowed to do
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.ObserveTip: Colony overview, colonists, resources, threats, research (status and switching), maps (listing and switching), map object search and game screenshots.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.WorkTip: Change work priorities and daily schedules. Easy to undo by hand.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.BuildTip: Mark things for mining, cutting, harvesting, deconstruction, hauling and hunting, and place blueprints.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.Combat: Combat — draft, move and attack orders
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.CombatTip: Draft colonists and give move or attack orders. The model needs several seconds to respond, so this is for positioning and retreats, not real-time control.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.Trade: Trade — list stock, buy and sell, player caravans
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.TradeTip: List what orbital traders and visiting caravans are selling, buy or sell in a single deal with the game's trade prices, and form player caravans.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.MedicalTip: Check colonist health (injuries, diseases, bleeding, operations) and change medical care levels.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.PrisonerTip: List prisoners and set their interaction mode (recruit, release, execution); recruitment and daily care still run through the game's warden mechanics.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AnimalTip: List animals, mark wild ones for taming, switch training on and off, and assign allowed areas. Taming and training run through the game's mechanics.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.ZoneTip: List zones, add stockpile and growing zones, delete zones, and change what stockpiles accept.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.ProductionTip: List work tables and their bills, add bills with a repeat count, and delete bills.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.TimeTip: Check the current time flow speed, pause the game, or switch between normal and fast speeds.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.MCP: MCP — external tools via local servers
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.MCPTip: Let the agent call tools from local MCP servers configured in AgentPack/MCP/servers.json. Servers run with your user privileges; only enable ones you trust.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.Mode.AskDesc: Read-only. The agent can inspect the colony and advise, but has no tools that change it.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.Mode.ConfirmDesc: Every command requires confirmation: any state-changing action is previewed and waits for your Confirm; queries run directly.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.Mode.YoloDesc: Between Confirm and Auto, no scheduler. Protected by a blacklist (high-risk tools like trade, caravans, surgery excluded); all other commands and MCP execute directly without confirmation.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.Mode.AutoDesc: A second model call judges each action (including MCP tools) on two axes: how risky it is, and whether your instruction asked for it. Only low-risk actions you asked for run directly; the rest wait for your Confirm. One extra request per action.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.ClassifierModelTip: Model used by Auto mode for risk classification. Choose from the entries in your RimLLM Framework fallback chain; Default follows the fallback chain.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.Mode.AutonomousDesc: Background scheduler runs autonomously. No restrictions on any behavior (no blacklist), no daily tool budget limit, MCP executes directly, operating on routine and events. Players can still give instructions anytime.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AutonomousHeader: Autonomy — the agent acts on its own
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AutoCooldownTip: Minimum wait time between two autonomous runs. Set to 0 to completely disable cooldown and react immediately to events and cycles.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AutoOnMentalBreak: React to colonists near mental break
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.FrameworkNote: Provider, API key, model and fallback chain are configured in RimLLM Framework's settings.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Model.DefaultTip: Use the RimLLM Framework fallback chain.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Model.Tip: Preferred model: {0} If it fails, the framework falls back along its fallback chain.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Slash.Undo: Undo the work settings changed by the last instruction
LanguageData.RimAgent.Slash.Unknown: Unknown command: {0}. Type / to see the available commands.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Slash.Busy: The agent is working; /stop it or wait for it to finish.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Goal.ListHeader: Persistent goals (run in order, separate from Autonomous mode):
LanguageData.RimAgent.Goal.Empty: No goals yet. Add one with /goal <text>, e.g. /goal research electricity.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Goal.Added: Queued goal #{0}; it will start shortly: {1}
LanguageData.RimAgent.Goal.Paused: Goal paused. Use /goal resume to continue.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Goal.NoSuch: There is no goal #{0}. Use /goal to list them.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Goal.Full: Goal limit reached; remove some with /goal remove <n>.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AutoOnEmergencyMedical: Respond to downed or bleeding colonists
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AutoOnRaidTip: Runs once when enemies actively threatening the colony appear on any map, and once more after they are all gone.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AutoOnMentalBreakTip: Runs when any colonist's mood drops below their minor mental break threshold.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AutoOnFoodShortageTip: Runs when total human-edible nutrition falls below 4 per colonist (about 2.5 days of food).
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AutoOnEmergencyMedical: Runs when any colonist is downed or bleeding.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AutoOnFireTip: Runs when fire appears on any map.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AutoCompactTip: When model history exceeds the threshold, older tool results are folded automatically before each request at no extra model cost; once history reaches twice the threshold, the oldest complete turns are dropped until it is back within the threshold (the visible log is kept). Manual /compact runs a separate LLM summary and is not affected by this switch.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AutoCompactThresholdTi: Uses the framework's model context limit and estimated history tokens. Auto-fold is unavailable when the limit is unknown.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.OpenLogFolderFailed: Could not open the log folder: {0}
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.RecordRunsTip: Writes instructions, model response summaries, tool arguments, and results to a separate JSONL file under RimWorld save data/RimAgent/RimAgent-runs.jsonl. Limited to 500 runs or 16 MiB; older records are removed. The file may contain player input and tool arguments. Internal reasoning that the model does not expose is unavailable.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Context.CompactOn: Model history: {0} messages; auto-fold threshold: {1}% of context window.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Context.CompactOff: Model history: {0} messages; auto-fold is off.
